subject: general
question: In which country is the Taklamakan desert located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Taklamakan Desert **is a desert in **Northwest China's southwestern Xinjiang province**.
 
• It is limited to the south by the Kunlun Mountains, to the west by the Pamir Mountains, to the north by the Tian Shan range, and to the east by the Gobi Desert.
 
• The Taklamakan Desert covers 337,000 square kilometres, making it somewhat smaller than Germany.
 
• It is part of the Tarim Basin, which is 1,000 kilometres (620 miles) long and 400 kilometres (250 miles) broad.
 
• It is traversed by two branches of the Silk Road at its northern and southern edges, as travellers attempted to escape the parched wasteland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **China**__:

 
 
• Capital: Beijing 
 
• Largest city: Shanghai
 
• President: Xi Jinping
